title: Ripperdoc gate policy (.ripperdoc/policy.json). Written by a human; the producer guard blocks agents from editing it.

ensemble.description: true: two reviewers on different models plus a merge; a single review does not pass

models.description: Model per ensemble role (claude --model). Empty or missing: the session default. b defaults to sonnet.

reruns.description: The only place rerun permission comes from in gated reviews. Empty: trace and recompute only.

review_dir.description: Where reviews live, relative to the project root. Default ripperdoc_reviews

stop_hook.description: review (default): the Stop hook runs the reviewer when no fresh review exists; check: it only decides from existing reviews

literature_search.description: Allow web literature search in gated reviews. Default false
